The Call

Humans are the least present we have ever been: distracted, divided, and isolated by increasingly lethal demands on our attention from technologies that have commodified it.

In our next chapter, we believe that general intelligence can liberate human attention just as it threatens to destroy it. We see a new horizon of presence and connection unlocked by unifying the timeless tools of ritual, ceremony, and togetherness with our emergent capacity to create anything we can imagine. Just as today’s AI takeoff is accelerating human capability across engineering, science, and creativity, we believe that it will equally propel talent, capital, and infrastructure aligned in service of the present moment.

We are doing this today at 25 Dobbin Street, a 20k square foot former parochial school on McCarren Park that we are turning into a center for the Brooklyn Renaissance.

We are a movement towards what Terence McKenna called the Archaic Revival.

In a present future, frontier technology blends seamlessly with the proven tools of the past to connect us with ourselves, each other, and the earth beneath our feet. Cryptography combines with general intelligence to enable us to collaborate without fear, and be vulnerable without exploitation. Armed with well-regulated nervous systems, increasingly capable AI allows each of us to become fully self-expressed, creating as we speak to share our deepest potential and uplift all of humanity. The values of radical self-reliance and communal effort stand in harmonious balance, scaffolded by our intention and energy to catalyze a renaissance in a beautiful transmutation of inner work to outer value.

How it works

Alignment is the alpha.

Capital from aligned investors, deployed by aligned operators, in service of aligned companies, supporting aligned communities, with surplus flowing to mission-locked charitable partners — this compounds more reliably than any combination of these things in isolation.

We put artists and engineers in the same building and give them reasons to help each other. Mendeleyev arrived with a rig worth rebuilding; guild engineers are turning it into software that lives on his iPad, and every stage he plays carries it further. Engineers give artists capability. Art becomes distribution for the technology — the collaboration builds distribution for each of them. We think this is a winning formula to win the culture.

What We Are

A guild in spirit, a studio in practice.

The guild operates at the intersection of pro-social technology, immersive art, and consciousness expansion. We invest in and incubate early-stage companies and cash-flow businesses, and we hold and activate real estate.

Equity goes wide, to the people who do the work: employees, advisors, creatives, partners, strategists, ceremonialists, and space holders.

The founders deliberately allocate themselves less than typical venture-backed startups. Shared upside attracts aligned talent, and stewardship of the mission stays primary.

How We Are Built

Built on first principles.

  • 100% member capital. ULPs — UnLimited Partners — whose check is the smallest thing they bring: expertise, deal flow, rooms, and relationships arrive attached.
  • Built for reinvestment. Surplus flows back into the spaces and the work.
  • Curated by invitation and referral. Capital joins the way people do: through relationship. The screen, in James’s words: “Have they done strange things in service of their own growth?”
The Architecture

How the pieces fit.

Apex · Delaware PBC

One Studio PBC

The apex. Its charter encodes the consciousness-aligned mission as the public benefit purpose, names the non-profits as critical to it, and binds long-term reinvestment.

Operating Subsidiary

One Sanctuary LLC

Holds the community-facing real estate and runs the physical and digital spaces. Membership dues and program fees sustain operations and grow the asset base.

Independent 501(c)(3)s

The New Old School & House of Blue Lotus

Independently governed charities, named in the charter as integral mission partners. Annual allocations — including equity through warrants — flow via a Donor-Advised Fund.

Equity Philosophy

The structure keeps stewardship ahead of wealth maximization.

30%

options pool for early employees and contributors. Very large by design.

10%

reserved for the non-profits named in the charter. The mission itself holds shares.

↔

mutual warrants: One Studio takes equity in every portfolio company; every portfolio company takes warrants in One Studio, vesting against milestones.

The Investment Thesis

We invest in creative technology, frontier science, and the tools of human coordination and privacy.

Our thesis is the flywheel: presence builds trust, trust opens connection, and connection returns people to presence. We invest at the intersections of Body, Mind, and Spirit, underwriting what our own people need and use. We lead where pipeline exists and build heavier infrastructure as the community grows into needing it.
